summary.occupancy_definition: ligand center (geometric, protein frame) within 6 A of crystal PC centroid (translated into DCD frame via backbone centroid offset, minimum-imaged per frame) AND >=1 catalytic heavy atom within 4.5 A
summary.units_note: box vectors scaled nm->A before imaging; all distances in A; crystal-center offset applied (see stdout)
summary.residue_selector: zero-based topology resSeq == Murcko ordinal (id2ord[r]); verified mapping 122->206 etc.

provenance: scripts/pocket_residence_r5fix.py — crystal PC center translated into DCD frame via backbone-centroid offset; zero-based residue selector; units note embedded. Supersedes pocket_residence.py (R3-1) and the r5fix variant without center transform. NOTE: the occupancy criterion was added post hoc during audit-driven analysis (not in the original pre-registration); radius sensitivity documented.
